SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   B. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

2. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

3. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

5. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

10. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   D. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
